title: Guard GitHub push actor attribution
summary: Add a pre-push guard that probes the actual GitHub transport credential before a branch ref update can create remote attribution under an unapproved account.
expectedFailureModes: Git author and committer metadata are neutral while the SSH key used for push resolves to an individual account.
A HTTPS push uses an approved local account that lacks write permission and would fail after validation.
A remote write bypasses GitHub CLI account validation because it uses SSH instead of HTTPS.
humanEscalation: Provision a repository-owned deploy key, GitHub App, or approved bot write credential before remote pushes resume.
nextAction: Keep remote writes blocked until the configured push credential resolves to an approved neutral account.
